absolute_tolerance_policy: atol_q=rtol*.01*min(qY_scale,qRZ_scale), atol_v=rtol*.01*min(vY_scale,vRZ_scale). One q atol is numerically shared by m/rad and one v atol by m/s/rad/s; no per-DOF tolerance facility is implied.
RK_equilibrium_qualification: Every accepted physical state is independently reassembled and its force balance norm is compared with1e-7. This is a mass-solve/physical-equilibrium check, not a Newton iteration tolerance; RK has no Newton precision-limited counter.

bending.mode: Highest of the independently derived two-DOF bending M,K eigenpairs; Newmark's original low-mode case is unchanged
bending.initial_state: q0=0; v0=omega_high*(Ay,r_high*Ay); actual consistent acceleration includes formal modal damping
bending.damping: Undamped and actual automatic modal Rayleigh with the original two low/high reference modes, both zeta=.02; check high-mode damping projection
bending.model_error_qualification: Both Y and RZ remain within twice their high-mode micro scales. Exact planar force terms beyond the linearized eigenmode are negligible at theta<=2e-7; the candidate is still checked against exact nonlinear force/potential and all six analytic state channels. No general spatial or continuum claim.

nonlinear.physical_model: Original single CR beam finite-amplitude Y/RZ, y0=.2m, theta0=0, zero velocity/load/damping, original two-high-frequency-period window
nonlinear.tangent_frequency_audit: Analytic symmetric Hessian of frozen exact U at all1025 finest independent reference positions, mass-normalized largest eigenvalue; maximum below zero-state omega_high. Not a candidate-derived step choice.

stability.qualification: This is the RK4 imaginary-axis linear stability bound. Nonlinear validity is additionally checked by the actual full response, exact force/mass, and frozen reference; initial spectrum alone is not a proof of nonlinear stability.

acceptance.reference_evaluation: Analytic selected high-mode damped/undamped q/v/a at actual times, and original finite-amplitude finest quintic Hermite q/v plus independent force/M acceleration; root also independently evaluates dense DOP853 at actual times. No linear interpolation of fixed-step candidate output.

limitations: Adaptive RK sees nonempty CR auxiliary rotations and currently uses a p=2 augmented-state controller. Coaxial planar Z rotations leave the principal inertia unchanged, so this does not force observed q/v/a order2; adaptive acceptance is tested by tolerance tightening, not a fixed-step order assertion.

Bending uses the actual AnalysisStep::Solve workflow to prepare formal modal damping; private RK counters are unavailable. Export raw successful checkpoint pushes, accepted frames and completed-run rejection estimate; fixed RK uses no adaptive checkpoint and rejection estimate is not invented.
No Newton residual/iteration or precision-limited count is attributed to RK; accepted physical residual is separately named.
All original fixed/adaptive Newmark inputs, modes, plans and gates retain their existing behavior.
